//: Expo Go will NOT run this app. @livekit/react-native and react-native-webrtc
are native modules, so every profile here produces a real native build.
EXPO_PUBLIC_ vars are baked in at BUILD time, which is why the experience
selector lives here and not in .env — a .env is gitignored and EAS never
uploads it. The gateway URL is deliberately NOT baked: it is an editable
field on the join screen, so one build works against any laptop on any wifi.
preview    Android APK, JS bundled, no Metro. The demo build — hand the
download link to anyone and they install it.
simulator  iOS Simulator .app. Free: no Apple Developer account needed.
device     Physical iPhone. Needs a paid Apple Developer account.
development  Dev client that connects to your Metro over the LAN.
